EmailSettings._comment: Fill these in to enable Gmail password-reset emails (Utils/EmailService.cs). SenderAppPassword must be a 16-character Gmail App Password, NOT your normal Gmail password — generate one at myaccount.google.com > Security > 2-Step Verification > App Passwords (2-Step Verification must be turned on first). Until this is filled in, the reset code is shown on-screen instead when running in Development, so the flow can still be tested.
